weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (silicone + cationic_polymer) converge and silicones are persistent; the convergence route toward high is plausible.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone plus guar plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded conditioning residue that an effective ordinary sulfate chassis largely rinses.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH (no payload lipid at all), reset is moderate, and the deposition is one silicone system plus one late guar without further converging families; it is not the W1 set (no amodimethicone), so W1 is not cited. Not low: two converging families with an early silicone make 'lightweight' an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone dose and guar charge density unknown; two converging families keep high realistic.
